name: Add stock
description: Add some of an item to stock, e.g. after shopping.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1)

place.description: Where it goes: a place name or code like "G2-4". Defaults to its usual place.

expires_on.description: Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today plus its shelf life.

name: Use stock
description: Take some of an item out of stock (soonest-expiring first). Rechargeables go flat instead.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1)

place.description: Only use stock from this place

name: Move item
description: Move an item to another place: for now (out of place) or for good (its usual place changes).

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

to.description: The place it's going to: a name or code

permanent.description: True if this is its new usual place

name: Put back
description: Put an out-of-place item back in its usual place.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Add expected delivery
description: Record something ordered but not arrived yet. It counts towards stock, so it isn't bought twice.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1)

source.description: Where it's coming from, e.g. "Tesco delivery" or "Amazon"

name: Mark arrived
description: A delivery arrived: everything from a source, or some of one item.

quantity.description: How many of the item arrived (default all expected)

name: Add to shopping list
description: Put an item on the shopping list even though it isn't low.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Remove from shopping list
description: Take an item that was added by hand off the shopping list.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Mark charged
description: Rechargeable batteries: some flat ones have been charged.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

quantity.description: How many, in the item's own unit (default 1)

name: Renew
description: A renewal (insurance, MOT, boiler service) has been renewed: restart its clock from today.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Find item
description: Look up an item: how many, where, and when it expires.

item.description: The item: its name or alias ("loo roll"), barcode, or id

name: Shopping list for a shop
description: Everything to buy at a shop: its favourites plus "any shop" items in categories it sells.

name: Batteries replaced
description: New batteries went into a device: takes them out of stock (rechargeables count as flat until charged).

device.description: The device, by name or Home Assistant device id
